scenario.title: 朋友搬家，大家來幫忙
scenario.context: 第二章的收尾：搬家這天會借東西、帶東西過去、交代誰說了什麼，正好碰上台灣人最常混用的幾組動詞：borrow / lend、bring / take、say / tell。前面學過的租屋、報修、家人、描述人也都會出現。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Hey, could you give me a hand with this sofa?
lines.zh: 嘿，可以幫我搬一下這張沙發嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Sure. Where should we take it?

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Take it down to the truck. My cousin's waiting there.
lines.zh: 搬下去卡車那邊，我表哥在那邊等。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Is there an elevator in this building?

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Nope. Four floors of stairs. Sorry!
lines.zh: 沒有，要走四層樓梯。抱歉！

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: No biggie. I've been hitting the gym, remember?
lines.zh: 沒差，我最近有在上健身房，記得嗎？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: You're a lifesaver. Oh, did Jess tell you she'd be late?
lines.zh: 你真是救星。對了，Jess 有跟你說她會晚到嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: She said something about borrowing her dad's car. She'll bring more boxes.
lines.zh: 她說要去借她爸的車，會帶更多箱子過來。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Sorry I'm late! My dad lent me his car, but it's been acting up.
lines.zh: 抱歉我遲到了！我爸借我他的車，但車子一直怪怪的。

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: No worries. Did you bring the tape?

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Oh no, I left it at home. Can I borrow yours?
lines.zh: 糟糕，我忘在家裡了。可以借你的嗎？

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Sure. Wow, what a nice view from here!
lines.zh: 好啊。哇，這裡的景色也太好了吧！

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I know! The landlord told me it gets great light in the afternoon, too.
lines.zh: 對吧！房東跟我說下午採光也很好。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Leo, you should throw a housewarming party.

lines.speaker: Leo
lines.en: Definitely. And pizza's on me tonight. I owe you guys one.
lines.zh: 一定要。今晚披薩我請，我欠你們一次。

patterns.en: Could you give me a hand with this?

chinglish.wrong: Can you borrow me your car?
chinglish.right: Can I borrow your car? / Can you lend me your car?
chinglish.why: 中文「借」不分方向。英文 borrow 是「借入」（主詞拿東西），lend 是「借出」（主詞給東西）。

chinglish.wrong: She said me she would be late.
chinglish.right: She told me she'd be late. / She said she'd be late.
chinglish.why: tell 後面直接接人；say 後面不能直接接人，要說 say to me。

chinglish.wrong: I will bring the boxes to your old place from here.
chinglish.right: I'll take the boxes to your old place.
chinglish.why: bring 是「帶過來（朝說話者或聽者的位置）」，take 是「帶過去（離開說話者）」。

chinglish.wrong: Very thank you for helping me move house.
chinglish.right: Thanks so much for helping me move.
chinglish.why: 複習第 19 單元：不要疊 very。另外口語 move 就夠了，move house 是英式說法。

grammar.title: 易混動詞 borrow/lend、bring/take、say/tell
grammar.oneLiner: borrow 借入、lend 借出；bring 帶來、take 帶去；tell 直接接人，say 不接人。
whenToUse: borrow（from 某人）：我從你那裡拿。Can I borrow your pen?
lend（某人 + 東西）：我給你用。Can you lend me your pen? / I lent him 500.
bring：朝向說話者或聽者所在的地方。Bring your laptop to the meeting.（會議是我們會在的地方）
take：離開說話者所在的地方。Take the trash out.
tell + 人 + 事：She told me the news. / Tell me about it.
say + 事（+ to 人）：She said it was fine. / What did he say to you?
固定用法：tell a story / tell the truth / tell a lie / tell a joke；say hello / say sorry / say yes。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的「借」「帶」「說」都不分方向和結構：「借我」「跟你借」「帶來」「帶去」「跟我說」全用同一個動詞加方向詞。英文則把方向直接放進動詞裡。這一組動詞沒有捷徑，要在每次開口前先想：東西往哪個方向移動？後面有沒有直接接人？

examples.incorrect: Can you borrow me your umbrella?

examples.correct: My sister lent me her car.
examples.incorrect: My sister borrowed me her car.
examples.note: 她借出給我用 lend，過去式 lent。

examples.correct: Can you bring some snacks when you come over?
examples.note: 東西要來到說話者這邊，用 bring。

examples.correct: Don't forget to take your jacket.
examples.note: 離開這裡時帶走，用 take。

examples.correct: He told me he was moving.
examples.incorrect: He said me he was moving.

quiz.question: Could you ___ me 200 dollars until Friday?
Can I ___ your charger for a sec?
You're coming to my place tonight? Great, ___ your guitar!
quiz.explanation: 帶到說話者這邊，用 bring。

quiz.question: What did the landlord ___ about the deposit? (say / tell)

slang.usage: 請人幫忙做體力或簡單的事：Can you give me a hand with this? 也可以說 lend me a hand。

risk.note: 語氣友善，同事、朋友、陌生人都能用。另外 give someone a big hand 是「給某人熱烈掌聲」。

examples.en: Can you give me a hand setting up the chairs?
Need a hand with those bags?

slang.meaning: 沒什麼大不了、小事一樁
slang.usage: no big deal 的更口語版本，回應道謝或道歉。

risk.note: 很隨興，對主管或客戶用 No problem at all 比較好。

examples.en: A: Sorry I forgot your book. B: No biggie, give it to me next time.
examples.zh: A：抱歉忘了帶你的書。 B：沒差，下次再給我。

examples.en: It's no biggie. I was going that way anyway.

slang.usage: 別人在緊要關頭幫了你，誇張地表達感謝。

risk.note: 友善的誇飾，對同事、主管都能用。

examples.en: You brought an extra charger? You're a lifesaver!
examples.zh: 你帶了備用充電器？你是我的救星！

examples.en: Thanks for covering my shift. You're a lifesaver.
examples.zh: 謝謝你幫我代班，你真是救星。

slang.meaning: 我欠你一次、欠你一個人情
slang.usage: I owe you one. 感謝對方幫忙，並表示下次會回報。

examples.en: Thanks for the ride. I owe you one.
You helped me move? I definitely owe you one.
examples.zh: 你幫我搬家？我絕對欠你一個人情。

review.question: ___ a beautiful apartment!
review.explanation: 複習第 19 單元：What a + 形容詞 + 名詞。

review.question: The boxes ___ to the new place yesterday.
review.explanation: 複習第 18 單元：箱子是被送的，用被動。

review.question: You just had surgery. You should take it ___ for a few weeks.
review.explanation: 複習第 17 單元：take it easy。

review.question: My mom's brother is my ___.
review.explanation: 複習第 16 單元：舅舅 = uncle。

review.question: I've decided ___ to a bigger apartment.
review.explanation: 複習第 14 單元：decide + to V。

review.question: Moving is so ___ (tire). I'm going to sleep for twelve hours.
review.explanation: 複習第 13 單元：造成疲累的事用 -ing。

review.question: Have you unpacked ___?
review.explanation: 複習第 12 單元：問句用 yet。

review.question: We ___ (take) three trips with the truck.
Thanks for helping me move. I ___ you one!
review.explanation: I owe you one = 欠你一次。
